verdict.rationale: uv can pin a Python version per directory via `uv python pin`, which writes `.python-version`, and that pin is respected. `uv run` also uses the project environment without manual activation. However, this only takes effect when you invoke uv commands; nothing shows tools activating automatically when you enter a directory. Missing for 10: shell-hook auto-activation on directory entry, per-project environment variable loading, and pinning of tool versions beyond Python.
